ExecuteSmartHomeScene.description_en: Execute a scenario configured by the User in the Whole House App that includes third-party devices.
ExecuteSmartHomeScene.description_zh: 执行全屋App中用户配置的包含三方设备的场景

GetSmartHomeSceneList.description_en: Obtain the User-configured scenario control List in the Whole House App that includes third-party devices.
GetSmartHomeSceneList.description_zh: 获取全屋App中用户配置的包含三方设备的场景控制列表

GetUserPhone.description_en: Retrieve the phone number attached to a Tmall Genie user
GetUserPhone.description_zh: 获取天猫精灵用户绑定的手机号

OAuth2TokenEndpoint.description_en:
The OAuth2 token endpoint currently supports the following two operations:  
Obtain an access_token by using an authorization code.  
Refresh an access_token by using a refresh token.
OAuth2TokenEndpoint.description_zh:
OAuth2令牌端点，目前支持以下两种操作：
通过code获取access_token。
通过refresh_token刷新access_token

QueryDeviceList.description_en: Provides third-party clients with a query for the list of devices that the user has authorized (the third party must have previously requested authorization for the PK list)
QueryDeviceList.description_zh: 提供给三方客户端查询用户已授权（三方需要提前申请授权的PK列表）的设备列表
